author: jeeves_ny
caption: Laundry detergent sheets are a scam and this is why. A single laundry sheet is just 4 grams of detergent (half of which is PVA plastic binder), when a large load needs at least 24 grams. You'd need 6 laundry sheets to hit the correct minimum dose... Laundry sheet companies took the "we're selling you water" complaint about liquid detergent and flipped it into "we're selling you air and plastic", dressed up in a cardboard box and marketed as the sustainable choice.  They have the solution (give you more product) and refuse to use it just to protect their margins. That's not disrupting an industry. That's greenwashing greed.  #LaundryTok #Greenwashing #SustainabilityMyth

author: jeeves_ny
caption: Ranking every laundry aisle product, 0-10: Baking soda 5/10 - helpful, but washing soda's higher pH beats it. Water softeners (borax, washing soda, Calgon) 8/10 - a must have if you have hard water. Check a hard water map if you're unsure. Vinegar 4/10 - too weak an acid to compete with real rinse products. Detergent sheets 2/10 - clean poorly, pricier than you'd think, only worth it for travel. High performance detergent 10/10 - the most important thing in your laundry room. Fabric softener 3/10 - outdated, makes clothes less absorbent. Softness is nice, but it's a tradeoff. Laundry sanitizers 9/10 - removes odor and kills microbes incredibly well. Acidic rinse products 8/10 - one of the best additions to the laundry aisle in the last decade. Enzymatic stain removers 10/10 - pretreating stains matters this much. Easy and powerful. Powdered oxygen bleach 9/10 - cheap, effective, brightens whites and lifts stains. Just a bit more process. Hydrogen peroxide 8/10 - great on blood, sweat, and whites. Dry in the shade, slightly weaker than oxygen bleach. Chlorine bleach 3/10 - has its place, but misuse causes irreversible damage. Scent beads 5/10 - no cleaning power, just fragrance. Total preference call. Enzyamtic boosters 10/10 - increases performance, and easy to use!  #Laundry #LaundryTips #LaundryHacks

author: jeeves_ny
caption: I called out laundry sheets months ago. Today I fixed them, for free!!! The problem: most sheets contain about 1/6th the detergent you need, and none of the ingredients that actually matter. No enzymes. No builders. No real surfactants. Just the bare minimum wrapped in a "sustainable" story. The fix was simple. I made a laundry sheet sandwich, added enzymes, oxygen bleach, chelants, and more surfactant. Mass / weight went from 4g to 24g. The result: a score of 71.2, right next to products that are genuinely good. Every sheet brand I've tested sits in the 20s, across roughly a dozen brands. You're not disrupting laundry. You're disrupting trust. Stop selling the packaging. Start selling performance. #Laundry #Sustainability #Greenwashing
